text: checkout-web runs on port 4173 in local development and proxies API calls to the backend on port 8081.
The ledger-sync worker consumes the Kafka topic ledger.events.v2 and commits offsets only after the database transaction has succeeded.
invoice-renderer generates invoice PDFs with Playwright, so the Docker image must include a headless Chromium.
The staging Postgres credentials are kept in Vault under secret/staging/postgres and must never be copied into .env files.
Marta Oliveira owns the payments on-call rota; page her before anyone touches the refund jobs.
The user wants commit messages in the imperative mood with the Linear issue key at the end, for example "Fix retry backoff (PAY-212)".
To regenerate the GraphQL types, run pnpm codegen from the repository root and then restart the dev server.
On 2026-10-14 geo-lookup ran out of memory after the MaxMind database update; the container memory limit was raised to 1 GiB.
The mobile app supports iOS 16 and later; dropping iOS 15 was agreed with the product team.
The reporting-api isolates tenants with PostgreSQL row-level security instead of filtering in application code, because a missing WHERE clause once leaked another customer's data.
The user prefers pull requests under 400 changed lines; anything bigger is split before review.
Before a release, bump versions with pnpm changeset version and check that CHANGELOG.md mentions every user-facing change.
session-broker keeps sessions in Redis with a 30-minute idle timeout and an absolute limit of 12 hours.
The nightly backup failed three nights in a row because an S3 lifecycle rule was deleting the staging prefix.
Feature flags are managed in Unleash; new-checkout-flow is switched on for 10% of users in Brazil.
The user dislikes default exports and wants named exports in every TypeScript module.
The flaky login test can be reproduced locally by running it with SLOW_NETWORK=1 and a fresh browser profile.
The support-etl job copies support tickets from Zendesk into the data warehouse every 15 minutes.
The design system lives in packages/ui and is built on Tailwind tokens; colours must come from the tokens file, never from hard-coded hex values.
On 2026-09-03 catalog-indexer rebuilt the Elasticsearch index from scratch after the analyzer change; the rebuild took about six hours.
Image uploads are capped at 10 MB, and the media pipeline resizes them to at most 2048 pixels wide.
All timestamps are stored in UTC, and they are converted to the user's time zone only in the browser.
The public API is versioned in the URL path (/v1, /v2), and /v1 will be switched off on 2027-03-31.
When a migration fails in production, never edit it: write a new forward migration and apply it with pnpm db:migrate.
The user wants error messages written for end users, with no stack traces or internal error codes.
push-gateway delivers notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) on Android and APNs on iOS.
The load test on 2026-08-21 showed checkout latency above 800 ms at 2,000 requests per second; the bottleneck was the tax calculation call.
Translations are managed in Crowdin; the source strings are in locales/en.json and CI pulls the other locales.
The team decided to stay on pnpm workspaces for the monorepo and not adopt Nx, to avoid another build layer.
The public API allows 100 requests per minute per API key, and the limit is enforced at the gateway.
To get production-like data locally, run scripts/seed-anonymised.sh; it never copies real email addresses.
The data warehouse is BigQuery in the europe-west1 region, and analysts query it through Metabase.
The user wants review comments to propose a concrete fix rather than only point out the problem.
An expired certificate took the partner webhook endpoint down on 2026-07-02; certificates are now renewed automatically by cert-manager.
The Android app is written in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, and the iOS app uses SwiftUI.
Every release candidate gets an accessibility audit with axe, and contrast failures block the release.
Passwords are hashed with Argon2id; bcrypt hashes from the old system are rehashed when the user next logs in.
To rotate the Stripe webhook secret, update it in Vault first and then redeploy billing-worker.
Application logs go to Grafana Loki and are kept for 30 days; errors are also sent to Sentry.
The user prefers explanations with a short code example over long theoretical answers.
checkout-web is deployed to Vercel.
checkout-web is now deployed to Cloudflare Pages instead of Vercel.
The code freeze before each release lasts two days.
The code freeze before each release has been shortened to one day.
ledger-sync runs on Node.js 20.
ledger-sync has been upgraded to Node.js 24.
The weekly design review takes place on Tuesdays at 10:00.
The weekly design review has moved to Thursdays at 14:00.
The mobile team builds its apps on Bitrise for CI.
The mobile team has moved its CI builds from Bitrise to GitHub Actions.
The orders-api returns 50 items per page by default.
The orders-api default page size was lowered to 25 items.
Jonas Weber is the tech lead of the search team.
Priya Raman has taken over as tech lead of the search team.
geo-lookup caches lookup results for 24 hours.
geo-lookup now caches lookup results for only 6 hours.
The staging environment is reset every Sunday night.
The staging environment is now reset every night at 02:00 UTC.
invoice-renderer uses the Inter font on invoices.
invoice-renderer switched to Noto Sans on invoices so that customer names in non-Latin scripts render correctly.
